name: TravelPlanner
description: Write a solve(question, llm) program that uses a budgeted OpenRouter LLM client to turn a TravelPlanner query and its reference information into a day-by-day JSON plan; scored by success rate on a fixed 20-query validation sample, a plan succeeding only if it passes all eight commonsense and all five hard constraints (higher is better).
